info.title: Cloudvoice REST API
info.description:
Our full rest api for managing resources.

**Authentication** — supply one of:
- `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` — obtained from `/v1/auth/login` or `/v1/auth/register`
- `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_<key>` — an API key created via `/v1/api-keys`

BearerAuth.description: Pass a JWT token or an API key prefixed with `sk_live_`.

contact.description: Dial string or UUID for uuid-standby agents

wrap_up_time.description: Seconds after a call before agent is offered another

freeswitch_uuid.description: FS channel UUID of the caller

event_types.description: Empty array means subscribe to ALL event types

jasmin_password.description: Plaintext password (admin-only route). Parity with sip_gateways.password.

QueuedSms.description: Response from POST /v1/sms — minimal fields available at submission time.

application_id.description: Default application for inbound calls to this user

password.description: Plaintext SIP password — shown ONCE at creation/rotation. Never retrievable afterwards; rotate if lost.

Call.description: Full call record returned by GET endpoints. Lifecycle fields (status, hangup_cause, duration_seconds, answered_at, ended_at) are nullable and fill in over time as the call progresses — poll, or subscribe to webhook events, to track changes.

gateway_id.description: Set for to.type=phone calls; null for sip/user

tag.description: Free-form customer metadata supplied at originate time

time_limit_secs.description: Hard cap on call duration in seconds

to_number.description: Display form of the dialled target — E.164 number, SIP URI, or user@realm depending on the to.type

CreatedCall.description: Response returned from POST /v1/calls. Only includes fields that have meaningful values at originate time. Use GET /v1/calls/:id to see lifecycle progress (status, duration, hangup_cause, etc.).

CallTarget.description: Typed destination. The `type` discriminator picks which other fields are required.

auth.description: Optional digest auth for type=sip when the URI 401-challenges. Password is NEVER stored or echoed in events.

outbound_proxy.description: Optional SIP proxy/SBC URI to route the outgoing INVITE through (type=sip only). Sets the FreeSWITCH `sip_route_uri` channel variable, which forces the INVITE to this address regardless of the Request-URI. Must be a valid `sip:` or `sips:` URI. Include `;lr` for RFC 3261 loose routing (recommended).

CallHeaders.description: Custom SIP headers added to the outgoing INVITE. Use X- prefixed names for portability. Values cannot contain CR/LF.

AmdConfig.description:
Answering Machine Detection configuration. When present with `enabled: true`, the platform runs mod_amd on the answered channel before executing the application flow. Detection result is stored on the call record (`amd_result`) and a `call.amd` webhook event is fired with `result` and `cause` fields.
**Results:** `human` | `machine` | `notsure` | `toolong`
**Causes:** `connect` (human answered) | `longgreeting` | `maxwords` | `initialsilence` | `maxwordlength` | `toolong` (analysis timed out)
**Tuning tips:**
  - Increase `maximum_number_of_words` (default 3) if real people are being
    misclassified as machines — 3 words is very aggressive.
  - Increase `after_greeting_silence` to wait longer for silence after a
    greeting before deciding the call is human.
  - `total_analysis_time` is a hard cap — AMD returns as soon as it reaches
    any decision, so the actual wait is usually much shorter.

silence_threshold.description: Energy threshold (0–32767) for classifying a frame as voiced vs. silent. Higher values require louder audio to be considered speech.

initial_silence.description: Maximum silence (ms) allowed before any speech is detected. If exceeded, result is `machine` / cause `initialsilence`.

greeting.description: Maximum duration (ms) of a single continuous utterance during the greeting phase. If exceeded, result is `machine` / cause `longgreeting`.

after_greeting_silence.description: Silence duration (ms) after the greeting that indicates a human. A human typically says "Hello?" and then waits.

total_analysis_time.description: Total time (ms) allowed for analysis. If no decision is made within this window, result is `notsure` / cause `toolong`. This is a maximum — AMD returns as soon as it reaches any decision.

min_word_length.description: Minimum duration (ms) of continuous voice to be considered a word.

maximum_word_length.description: Maximum duration (ms) of a single word. If exceeded, result is `machine` / cause `maxwordlength`.

between_words_silence.description: Silence duration (ms) between words that separates one word from the next.

maximum_number_of_words.description: Maximum number of words allowed before classifying as machine. If exceeded, result is `machine` / cause `maxwords`. **Increase this (e.g. to 6) if real people are being misclassified.**

ApplicationConfig.description: Application-level configuration. All fields are optional and merge with system defaults. Adding new keys is non-breaking.

record_calls.description: Record every call attached to this application unless overridden per-call. Recordings are accessible via the `/v1/recordings` API once they're uploaded after the call ends.

FlowDefinition.description: An ordered list of verbs (Jambonz-style). Executed top-to-bottom. Only `gather` branches; all other verbs are sequential. See docs/APPLICATIONS.md for fully worked examples.

url.description: A single URL or an array of URLs (played in sequence).

seekOffset.description: Samples to seek into the URL

prompt.description: Optional prompt to play before collecting digits.

branches.description: Map of exact digit string → child verb array.

defaultVerbs.description: Verbs to run when no branch matches (timeout/invalid input).

url.description: Path/URL the recording is written to

finishOnKey.description: Stop recording on this DTMF (single char)

VerbSay.description: STUB — TTS not yet configured. The verb is accepted but skipped at runtime.

reason.description: Free-text reason for the hangup. If it matches a known SIP cause string (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE like USER_BUSY, CALL_REJECTED, etc.) it's used as the SIP hangup cause. Any other value is stamped on the outgoing BYE as `X-Reason` and the cause defaults to NORMAL_CLEARING.

headers.description: Custom SIP headers to include in the outgoing BYE. Use X- prefixed names for compatibility — many SIP stacks only forward X- headers on BYE without extra config.

VerbQueue.description: Place the caller into a mod_callcenter queue. The call is held with hold music until an available agent bridges in, the caller hangs up, or `maxWaitSecs` expires. Flow execution blocks until one of those outcomes occurs, then continues with the appropriate branch verbs.

queue_id.description: ID of the call_center_queues row to place the caller into. The queue must belong to your organisation and be active. Obtain this from GET /v1/call-center/queues.

maxWaitSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and running timeoutVerbs. Defaults to 600 (10 minutes).

answeredVerbs.description: Verbs to execute after an agent answers and the call is bridged. Runs on the caller's leg. If omitted the flow simply continues to the next top-level verb once the bridge ends.

timeoutVerbs.description: Verbs to execute when maxWaitSecs expires and no agent has answered. Typical use: play an apology message then hangup, or redirect to voicemail.

abandonVerbs.description: Verbs to execute when the caller hangs up while waiting in the queue (before an agent answers). Useful for logging or sending a callback SMS. Note: the channel is already gone at this point so any verbs that require an active channel (play, gather, dial) will be silently skipped.

Places an outbound call. Status updates (ringing, answered, completed, failed)
are delivered in real-time via **WebSocket events** and **webhooks** — no polling required.

---

### Destination types (`to.type`)

#### `phone` — Dial out via a SIP trunk
Routes the call through a configured SIP gateway. Auth, codecs, and proxy
are taken from the gateway configuration.
```json
{
  "to": {
    "type": "phone",
    "number": "+27123456789",
    "gateway_id": "<uuid>"
  }
}
```
**Required:** `number` (E.164 format), `gateway_id`

---

#### `sip` — Dial a SIP URI directly
Sends the INVITE directly to any SIP URI using a named Sofia profile.
Useful for calling SIP endpoints, SBCs, or inter-system trunks without
configuring a gateway.
```json
{
  "to": {
    "type": "sip",
    "sip_uri": "sip:bob@example.com:5060",
    "profile": "external",
    "auth": {
      "username": "bob",
      "password": "secret"
    },
    "outbound_proxy": "sip:192.168.1.50:5060;lr"
  }
}
```
**Required:** `sip_uri` (must include `sip:` or `sips:` scheme)

**Optional fields:**
- `profile` — Sofia profile to use (default: `external`)
- `auth` — Digest credentials if the endpoint issues a 401 challenge.
  The password is **never stored or echoed** in events.
- `outbound_proxy` — Route the INVITE through a SIP proxy or SBC before
  it reaches the destination URI. Must be a valid `sip:`/`sips:` URI.
  Include `;lr` for RFC 3261 loose routing (e.g. `sip:192.168.1.50:5060;lr`).

---

#### `user` — Call a registered SIP extension
Resolves a SIP user registered with the platform and delivers the call
directly to their device — no gateway or profile required.
```json
{
  "to": {
    "type": "user",
    "user": "1001@sip.example.com"
  }
}
```
**Required:** `user` in `extension@realm` format

---

### Call control options
- **`application_id`** — Run a call-flow application once the call answers
  (play audio, collect digits, bridge, etc.).
- **`record_calls`** — Enable recording for this call, overriding the
  application's default.
- **`amd`** — Answering Machine Detection. Fires a `call.amd` webhook event
  with the result before the application flow starts.
- **`time_limit`** — Hard cap on call duration (seconds). The call is
  automatically ended when reached.
- **`headers`** — Custom `X-` SIP headers added to the outgoing INVITE.
- **`tag`** — Free-form metadata echoed in all webhook events for this call.

from.description: Outbound caller ID number in E.164 format. Both `caller_id_number` and `caller_id_name` get this value. Falls back to the gateway's configured caller ID for type=phone, or to the platform's profile defaults for type=sip/user.

from_host.description: Override for the SIP From: URI hostname. Some carriers require a specific domain in From for their identity / PAI checks.

application_id.description: Optional application (call-flow) to drive the call once it answers. When set, the platform parks the channel after answer and the flow executor walks the application's verbs. When omitted, the call hangs up immediately after the dial completes. The flow version is snapshotted at originate time.

record_calls.description: Per-call recording override. Resolution order: `record_calls` body field → application's `config.record_calls` → `false`.

time_limit.description: Hard cap on the call duration in seconds. The call is hung up with cause ALLOTTED_TIMEOUT when reached. Counts from answer.

tag.description: Free-form customer metadata stored on the call row and echoed in webhook events. Not pushed to SIP signalling. Capped at ~64KB serialised.

answer_on_bridge.description: When true, the platform leaves the A-leg in early-media until the B-leg actually connects. Only useful when the application bridges.

ignore_early_media.description: Ignore 183 Session Progress on the outbound leg. Useful when a carrier sends early media that would otherwise cause the platform to consider the call "answered".

amd.description: Optional Answering Machine Detection. Requires `application_id` to be set — AMD runs after the call answers and before the application flow starts. A `call.amd` webhook event is fired with the detection result. The flow then continues regardless of the result; use the `call.amd` event to branch your logic.
